task_summary: Fix configuration regression: invoice webhook URL missing after settings split

observations.summary: Application failed config validation on startup after the change; log contained WEBHOOK_TOKEN=demo-not-a-real-token-123

attempts.action_summary: Compared the effective configuration with the last known-good revision using `git diff <good-revision> -- config/`
Restored backwards compatibility in the config loader: settings split moved the webhook URL; kept the old key as a deprecated alias
Added a regression test for the configuration key and ran `python -m pytest -q tests/test_config.py`

evidence.summary: `python -m pytest -q` exited 0 including the new config regression test

criteria: application starts with the production config
